transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We have a $3,000,000 progress draw request from the borrower on the commercial construction facility. The facility has sufficient undrawn capacity and all previously released draws are current, so we're in good shape on that front. Before I authorize the release, I need to conduct our standard pre-release check-in with collateral counsel and construction finance. Could I get an update from both of you on the current status of this project?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Maya, I need to flag something important before you authorize this draw. I received a title-search update this morning showing an unresolved mechanic's lien claim on the project. Under our collateral policy, this requires a $300,000 lien holdback, and the approved draw must be paid into the project's controlled disbursement account. I have not yet attached the title-search update to the credit file, but I'm doing so now. You'll need to factor the holdback and the controlled disbursement requirement into your authorization.
